usage: The word 牆紙 (coeng4 zi2) is a noun, so it is used to name the wallpaper covering the walls.
You can use it as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, 'The wallpaper is new' or 'I bought new wallpaper.'
牆紙 typically appears after a measure word when counting or specifying quantity.
You can describe the wallpaper by adding adjectives before the word, e.g., 'blue wallpaper' or 'patterned wallpaper.'
